prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- sign_in: 76.6%, median 3s / mean 567s

- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Mini Game Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a centered interactive card with a tip carousel and desktop control shortcuts to keep users engaged during generation. (why: The home waiting step has an extremely high mean wait time of 2336s and 201s median, causing user drop-off while waiting for pet rendering.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Guide Screen: Add a new interactive quick controls screen right before home_intro that demonstrates desktop shortcuts, context menus, and hiding features. (why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Benefit Headlines: Rewrite headline and body on the choose_path screen to contrast quick ready-to-adopt pets against custom avatar creation. (why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s, indicating confusion between preset options and custom generation.)
3: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Layout with Mascot: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to split view and include a cheerful pet mascot component. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.6%; elevating visual celebration reinforces the emotional payoff of adopting a pet.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Stalling Troubleshooter Button: Add a sign-in troubleshooter action button on the sign_in screen to resolve freeze or webview loading delays. (why: Support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to load before users could authenticate.)

scores.note: High mean wait time causes drop-off at home step, but interactive mini-game requires significant code effort.
Finish step has lowest conversion (64.8%) and explicit support tickets, but requires a new guide screen.
Long mean duration on path choice targeted with simple copy changes that can be configured without a new release.
Adoption step drops to 69.6%; split layout and visual updates require UI rework.
Sign-in drop-off aligns directly with support reports of webview stalling; action button offers quick recovery.
